Sweeping Edge: Sweeping Edge is an enchantment applied to swords that increases sweep attack damage. This only affects the damage of the sweep attack against other surrounding entities, and does not increase damage against the entity that is attacked directly. Sweeping Edge is not required to do sweep attacks, as swords have the ability innately.​[until: JE Combat Tests]
Swift Sneak: Swift Sneak is an enchantment applied to leggings that lessens the movement speed reduction that occurs when sneaking.
Thorns: Thorns is an armor enchantment that gives a random chance to damage entities that attack the user, at the cost of increasing incurred durability damage.
Unbreaking: Unbreaking is an enchantment that gives a chance for an item to avoid durability reduction when it is used, effectively increasing the item's durability.
Wind Burst: Wind Burst is an enchantment applied to maces that causes a powerful upward knockback effect to be created upon executing a smash attack. Unlike wind charges, Wind Burst does not negate fall damage.
Aqua Affinity: Aqua Affinity is an enchantment applied to helmets that removes the mining speed reduction that occurs when underwater.
Bane of Arthropods: Bane of Arthropods is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, spears, and maces that substantially increases melee damage against arthropod mobs and applies Slowness IV to them.
Blast Protection: Blast Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage taken from explosions and fireworks and increases explosion knockback resistance.
Breach: Breach is an enchantment applied to maces that causes melee attacks to partially ignore armor, increasing damage against armored targets. It also affects the natural armor points that certain mobs have innately.
Channeling: Channeling is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes a lightning strike when thrown at an entity or lightning rod during a thunderstorm (in Java Edition) or at a lightning rod during any type of rain (in Bedrock Edition).
Cleaving: Cleaving is an enchantment applied to axes that increases melee damage and lengthens shield disabling time. It is exclusive to the Java Edition Combat Tests.
Curse of Binding: Curse of Binding is an enchantment that prevents the item from being removed from armor slots.
Curse of Vanishing: Curse of Vanishing is an enchantment that causes the item that it is applied to to disappear upon death.
Density: Density is a mace enchantment that increases the damage of smash attacks.
Depth Strider: Depth Strider is an enchantment applied to boots that lessens the movement speed reduction that occurs when in water.
Efficiency: Efficiency is an enchantment applied to tools that increases mining efficiency.
Feather Falling: Feather Falling is an enchantment applied to boots that reduces fall damage.
Fire Aspect: Fire Aspect is an enchantment applied to swords, maces, and spears that ignites entities hit with melee attacks.
Fire Protection: Fire Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage received from fire. It also reduces burning time.
Flame: Flame is an enchantment applied to bows that causes arrows to be set on fire.
Fortune: Fortune is an enchantment applied to tools that gives a chance to receive more item drops from certain blocks.
Frost Walker: Frost Walker is an enchantment applied to boots that turns water into frosted ice beneath the user's feet, and provides immunity to campfire and magma block damage.
Impaling: Impaling is an enchantment applied to tridents that substantially increases damage against aquatic mobs,‌[JE  only] or increases damage against entities in water or rain.‌[BE  only]
Infinity: Infinity is an enchantment applied to bows that prevents consumption of arrows, except for spectral arrows or tipped arrows.
Knockback: Knockback is an enchantment applied to swords and spears that increases melee knockback.
Looting: Looting is an enchantment applied to swords and spears  that gives a chance to receive more item drops from certain mobs.
Loyalty: Loyalty is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes a thrown trident to fly back to the player who threw it after it lands.
Luck of the Sea: Luck of the Sea is an enchantment applied to fishing rods that increases the rate of treasure items from fishing.
Lunge: Lunge is an enchantment applied to spears that causes jab attacks to propel the wielder forward horizontally. When used, Lunge consumes saturation and hunger at an amount dependent on the enchantment level, as well as 1 durability. The distance gained from Lunge is increased when in midair.
Lure: Lure is an enchantment applied to fishing rods that decreases the wait time for bites when fishing.
Mending: Mending is an enchantment that restores an item's durability when a player collects experience orbs.
Multishot: Multishot is an enchantment applied to crossbows that makes firing one shoot three copies of the loaded projectile in a fixed spread, at the cost of draining more durability.
Piercing: Piercing is an enchantment applied to crossbows that allows fired arrows to damage and fly through multiple entities, including shields, without being consumed.
Potatofication: Potatofication is a joke enchantment added in 24w14potato.
Power: Power is an enchantment applied to bows that increases arrow damage.
Projectile Protection: Projectile Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that reduces damage received from arrows, tridents, and any other projectiles.
Protection: Protection is an enchantment applied to armor that adds bonus damage reduction.
Punch: Punch is an enchantment applied to bows that increases arrow knockback.
Quick Charge: Quick Charge is an enchantment applied to crossbows that reduces charge time.
Respiration: Respiration is an enchantment applied to helmets that extends underwater breathing time.
Riptide: Riptide is an enchantment applied to tridents that causes the trident to launch the user when used in water or rain, replacing the trident's ability to be thrown as a projectile.
Sharpness: Sharpness is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, and spears that increases melee damage.
Silk Touch: Silk Touch is an enchantment applied to tools that causes certain blocks to drop themselves instead of their normal drops.
Smite: Smite is an enchantment applied to swords, axes, spears, and maces that substantially increases melee damage against undead mobs.
Soul Speed: Soul Speed is an enchantment applied to boots that causes faster movement on soul sand and soul soil, but slowly drains durability in the process.
